arabic text:
MANI KE HAR NAFASAM ESME TO GOFTAM
NAKONEYE-ROOZI AS CHISHAAT BIOFTAM
BE MANE MORRDE YE JOONE-TAAZE DAADI
BARAA NOKARI BE MAN, EJAAZE DAADI
english translation text:
I HAVE CALLED OUT YOUR NAME WITH EVERY BREATH,
I AM AFRAID OF (MY STATURE) GOING DOWN IN YOUR EYES,
YOU HAVE GIVEN A DEAD MAN NEW LIFE,
YOU HAVE GIVEN ME PERMISSION TO SERVE YOU

arabic text: BENEVISID, ROOYE SANGE GHABRE MAN\nALAME ROYAAYE MAN\nDEENE MAN DONYAYE MAN
english translation text: YOU ARE THE BASE OF MY DREAMS,\nYOU ARE MY DEEN, YOU ARE MY WORLD,\nWHEN I DIE WRITE THIS ON MY GRAVE

arabic text: DONYAYE MAN, AAGHAYE MAN\nMAN BARAAYE TO, GERYE MEEKONAM, TO BARAAYE MAN AAGHAYE MAN\nALLAHOMMAJ’AL MAHYAAYA MAHYAAYE MAN
english translation text: MY WORLD, MY MASTER, OH ALLAH MAKE ME\nFOLLOW THE FOOTSTEPS OF HUSSAN, I CRY FOR\nYOU AND YOU FOR ME MY MASTER

arabic text:
I AM THE DUST BENEATH THE DUST OF YOUR LAND
I AM A BEGGAR TO YOU I’M REACHING MY HAND
YOU ARE THE SUN BEHIND THE CLOUDS THOUGH FAR YOU ARE NEAR
EVEN IF I DON’T SEE YOU I KNOW YOU ARE THERE
THEY SAY DEATH SURROUNDED YOU\nSTILL I CAME RUNNING TO YOU\nTO BE WITH THE MILLIONS OF LOVERS WHO CAME

I’M AT YOUR DOOR
I’M AT YOUR DOOR
AND I AM KNOCKING, PLEADING LET ME IN TO YOUR REMORSE
PLEASE DON’T TURN AWAY FROM ME, YOU’RE MY ONLY HOPE
MY ONLY HOPE
I AM DROWNING YOU’RE MY AIR\nYOU’RE THE COMFORT TO MY FEARS\nAND I WRITE YOUR HOLY NAME ON EVERY TEAR
